editorial.blurb: Nobu Chicago delivers elevated Japanese cuisine in a stylish, welcoming atmosphere with impeccable service—a memorable destination for special occasions, though the premium pricing reflects the refined experience.
editorial.insiderTip: Skip the brunch buffet (reviewers found it overpriced at $75-80 per person) and instead book the 7-course omakase experience ($195/person) for a more focused, curated meal that showcases the kitchen's attention to detail.
